comment: Published releases of invisible-core, one entry per version that actually reached the index. Written only by scripts/version_gate.py record. Never hand-edited, and never shipped inside the package (a ledger that ships would invalidate the digest it certifies). This file must EXIST and PARSE on every gate run: an absent or unreadable ledger is exit 4, never a pass, because losing the gate's only offline memory is exactly how a content change under an unmoved version slips out. Empty is not self-evidently a first release either - it is equally what a ledger that lost its entries looks like - so release 1 has to be stated with `check --first-release`, once, and never again, and that statement is cross-checked against the index (forced, not optional: an empty ledger holds no earlier content, so it is the one state in which the gate compares nothing at all, and 'nothing has been published' is the one claim the index can settle outright). Each entry corroborates itself: the wheel_filename and sdist_filename carry the same version as the version field, and each digest hashes the files table beside it. An entry that disagrees with itself is exit 2, not a verdict.
